blocks.title: Ferrofluid
blocks.text: Ferrofluid anokha maadda hai jo liquid aur magnetic dono khusoosiyat rakhta hai; yeh magnetic aur fluid dynamics ke usoolon ke mel se kaam karta hai. Asal mein ferrofluid ek carrier fluid, jaise tel ya pani, mein magnetic zarron ka colloidal suspension hai.

Aam taur par magnetic zarre iron oxide hote hain jo nano paimane tak pise hote hain, taqreeban 10 nanometres ke. In zarron par surfactant ki teh (coating) chadhai jati hai, jo sath ka tanao (surface tension) kam karne wala maadda hai. Yeh teh zarron ko aapas mein chipakne se rokti hai aur unhein fluid mein barabar phaila rakhti hai. Fluid ki gaarhapan (viscosity), zarron ka nanometre size aur un ki musalsal harkat unhein neeche baithne se rokte hain.

Jab qareeb koi magnet na ho to ferrofluid liquid ki tarah behta hai; magar magnet qareeb ho to zarre waqti taur par magnetize ho jate hain aur fluid magnet ban jata hai. Woh fluid ke andar dhanche banate hain, jis se ferrofluid zyada solid ki tarah lagta hai. Magnet hatane par zarre demagnetize ho jate hain aur ferrofluid phir liquid ki tarah behta hai. Pehla ferrofluid NASA mein Steve Papell ne 1960s ke shuru mein (1963 ke qareeb) qudrati magnetite pees kar banaya; yeh khala (space) mein liquids chalane ke liye ijad hua (For Your Information).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke pehla ferrofluid NASA ne 1960 mein banaya. Asal mein NASA ke Steve Papell ne yeh 1960s ke shuru mein banaya; us ke tareeqe ka patent 1963 mein darj hua. Is liye 1960 ka saal theek nahi, 'early 1960s (taqreeban 1963)' sahi hai.

Yeh mazhar magnetic forces, sath ke tanao aur gravity ke muqable ki wajah se hai. Taqatwar magnetic field mein zanjeer jaise dhanche bante hain kyunke magnetic forces fluid ko oopar khainchti hain jabke gravity aur sath ka tanao use neeche khainchte hain. Yeh zanjeerein magnetic field lines ke saath seedh mein aati hain aur gaarhapan barhati hain, jis se fluid kuch simton mein ubharte solid ki tarah lagta hai; in ubharon ko aam taur par spikes kehte hain. Spikes wahan bante hain jahan magnetic forces doosri forces par ghalib aa jati hain (Fig. 10.17).

blocks.alt: Saada khaaka: bar magnet (N surkh, S neela) ke oopar rakhi plate par kaala ferrofluid nukeele kaanton (spikes) ki shakal mein khara hai; beech ke kaante sab se oonche hain. Labels: ferrofluid, magnet.
blocks.caption: Ferrofluid ke kaante (spikes) magnet ke oopar: hamara saada khaaka (kitab ki Fig. 10.17 photo hai; yeh us ki tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Magnet ki field lines ke saath ferrofluid ke zarre zanjeeron mein jur kar oopar khinchte hain, jabke gravity aur sath ka tanao (surface tension) unhein neeche kheenchte hain. Jahan magnetic force jeet jati hai wahan kaante bante hain. Magnet hata dein to zarre magnetism kho dete hain aur fluid phir hamwar liquid ban jata hai.

Aap ko laser printer ka toner, kuch khane ka tel, test tube, sheeshe ki botal, chhoti chhari aur magnet chahiye. Tareeqa: test tube mein kuch toner dalein; laser printer toner mein nanometre size ka 40% iron oxide hota hai. Kuch khane ka tel mila kar chhari se achi tarah ghol kar ferrofluid banayein, aur yeh fluid botal mein dalein. Botal hilane par fluid liquid ki tarah behta hai. Ab botal ke bahar se magnet fluid ke qareeb layein: fluid magnet ki taraf uchhalta hai, kyunke woh khud magnet ban gaya hai. Agar magnet botal ki bagal mein rakhein to fluid ka banaya spikes wala dhancha nazar aata hai (Fig. 10.18).

items: Electronics: ferrofluids computer hard drives aur doosri ghoomti shaft wali motors ki rotary seals mein istemal hote hain. Loudspeakers mein yeh voice coil ko thanda karte hain jo kaam ke doran garam ho sakti hai: magnetic field fluid ko coil ke gird thame rakhti hai, jis se woh heat behtar jazb aur kharij kar pata hai. Yeh speakers mein larzish (vibration) kam karte aur awaz ka maiyar behtar karte hain.

Tib (medicine): ferrofluids bairooni magnets se jism ke khaas hisson ki taraf bheje ja sakte hain, jis se nishana-band dawa pohanchana (targeted drug delivery) mumkin hai. Magnetic zarre dawa seedhe rasoli (tumour) ya kisi aur nishane tak le ja sakte hain, jis se mazar asraat (side effects) kam aur ilaaj zyada moassar hota hai. Ferrofluids magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) mein contrast agents ke taur par bhi istemal ho sakte hain.

Doosre istemalat mein larzish kam karna, ya magnetic field badal kar liquids ka bahao durusti se qaboo karna shamil hai. Ferrofluids electronics, tib, engineering aur physics aur materials science ki tehqeeq mein istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Ferrofluids kaise kaam karte hain, wazeh kijiye (comprehensive question 10.6).
blocks.explanation: Iron oxide ke nanometre zarre, surfactant ki teh ke saath ta ke alag rahein, tel ya pani mein phaile hote hain. Field na ho to zarre be-tarteeb rukh mein hote hain aur liquid aam tarah behta hai. Magnetic field mein har zarra nanha magnet ban jata hai; zarre field lines ke saath zanjeeron mein seedh mein aate hain, jo gaarhapan barhata hai aur liquid ko wahan spikes mein khainchta hai jahan magnetic force gravity aur sath ke tanao par ghalib ho. Field hatane par zarre apna magnetism kho dete hain aur fluid phir behta hai.
